name: DAVIS
description: Classic video object segmentation benchmark with densely annotated, pixel-accurate per-frame ground truth on high-quality video sequences. Used to compare methods for segmenting target objects consistently across time.
evaluation_method: region similarity and boundary metrics, commonly J&F measure (Jaccard/IoU plus contour accuracy) averaged over sequences
notes: Consists of fifty Full HD video sequences with dense ground truth, covering occlusions, motion blur, and appearance changes. It is a foundational benchmark in video object segmentation and is widely used for standardized comparison. Exact question count is not applicable in the usual sense. Citations reported: 2261.
